F.1/56(16)/2026-R.III
F.1/57(17)/2026-R.III
UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
R-III SECTION
NOTICE
It is notified for information of all concerned that, for the posts of
Principal and Vice Principal in the Education Department, Government of
NCT of Delhi, advertised vide the Commission's Special Advertisement No.
51/2026, reservation under OBC Category will be provided only to those
candidates who submit OBC certificates issued by Govt. of NCT of Delhi.
Candidates who submit OBC Certificate issued by other States/UTs will be
considered as General/Unreserved candidates against General/Unreserved
vacancies.
2. OBC candidates are, therefore, advised to refer to the above mentioned
condition as prescribed under “ANY OTHER CONDITIONS” against the posts
of Principal and Vice Principal at Item Nos. 1 and 2, respectively, of Special
Advertisement No. 51/2026, in place of the following general instruction
contained in Note (b) under the heading "CANDIDATES TO ENSURE THEIR
ELIGIBILITY FOR THE RECRUITMENT":
“A candidate will be eligible to get the benefit of community reservation only in
case the particular caste to which the candidates belong is included in the list
of reserved communities issued by the Central Government.”
3. Further, candidates belonging to the Delhi OBC category who are
unable to locate the serial number of their caste in the Central List while
filling out the Common Application Form (CAF) may enter "0" or "NA" in the
relevant field of the CAF.
Deputy Secretary (R.III)
